description: If the bowl (or gripper) ever comes within 0.15m of the stove at any point during the episode, the bowl must end on the plate instead of in the drawer; otherwise it must end in the top drawer of the cabinet.
note: The .bddl file's native :goal is a coarse (Or drawer-goal plate-goal) stand-in for the engine's built-in check_success(), which has no trajectory memory and can't evaluate the trigger. Correctly verifying which branch was actually required needs a trigger-aware checker that tracks bowl-to-stove distance over the full episode (not yet implemented).
